company_name: 莱克电气股份有限公司
decision_frame: Assess the durability of the consolidated appliance and motor enterprise at the 2018-12-31 information cutoff, separating mature earnings, cash conversion, financing pressure and unproved growth.
underwriting_route: Pre-outcome enterprise underwriting using FY2015-FY2017 annual-report evidence; no market-price or return conclusion is made.

situation_model.summary: Revenue rose through FY2017 while adjusted profit and operating cash fell from FY2016; the company combines domestic brands, overseas ODM and several cleaning-appliance categories.

industry_future_thesis.most_likely_regime: Competitive small-appliance markets remain innovation- and channel-driven, with input-cost and customer bargaining pressure producing mixed margins.
industry_future_thesis.profit_pool_transmission: Profit accrues to differentiated branded products and efficient ODM execution; raw-material inflation, FX and working-capital requirements can absorb operating gains.
industry_future_thesis.company_exposure: LEXY, Bewinch and Jimmy brands use domestic distributor, direct and online channels, while international sales are primarily ODM private-label supply.
industry_future_thesis.adaptation: The disclosed adaptation is continued product/category expansion and mixed brand/ODM channels; segment-level profitability and cash transmission are not disclosed.
industry_future_thesis.normal_economics: Mature economics are evidenced at consolidated level only: FY2015-FY2017 adjusted net profit was RMB345.8m, RMB465.8m and RMB341.0m, with operating cash declining to RMB214.2m in FY2017.
industry_future_thesis.permanent_loss: Permanent-loss risk is driven by sustained margin pressure, working-capital absorption and retention into unproved categories; solvency appears supported by cash but shareholder accessibility and incremental returns are not fully mapped.
industry_future_thesis.valuation_treatment: Use a consolidated mature owner-cash route as primary, keep brand/category growth conditional, and exclude unproved growth-return value from the base.
industry_future_thesis.strongest_rival: A scaled appliance competitor with stronger brand pull and channel economics could capture branded profit pools while forcing 莱克电气 to compete on price, compressing margins and cash conversion.
reversal_observations: Post-cutoff reports show adjusted profit and operating cash recovering together without disproportionate working-capital growth.
Disclosures identify customer concentration, brand/ODM economics and subsidiary cash accessibility sufficiently to reconcile earnings to ordinary-shareholder cash.
New category or capacity investments report matched incremental earnings and owner cash after total working-capital and long-lived-asset spending.

business_position: The company has core motor technology, domestic brands and broad international ODM coverage, but the top five customers still represented 39.81% of FY2017 revenue and customer names and segment economics are undisclosed.
survival_case: FY2017 cash and cash equivalents were RMB1.952bn and no restricted cash or pledged assets were reported; however, FY2017 showed RMB300m due within one year and prior borrowing had risen to RMB680m, so liquidity depends on continued operating cash and bank access.
adaptation_case: Management broadened green small-appliance categories and maintained agency, direct and online domestic channels alongside ODM exports. This supports strategic optionality, but no source isolates returns by brand, ODM, product or newly formed subsidiary.
normalization_case: Use FY2015-FY2017 adjusted net profit as a consolidated reference range, with FY2017 conservatively informative because raw-material and FX pressure coincided with lower profit and cash. Brand/channel uplift remains conditional rather than a base adjustment.
permanent_loss_map: Permanent loss can arise slowly through margin erosion, rising receivables and inventory, and retention into categories without demonstrated incremental returns. FY2017 receivables reached RMB1.079bn and inventory RMB729m; inaccessible subsidiary cash and customer concentration remain unresolved local risks.

value_route.route_reasoning: A consolidated owner-cash route is the only currently supportable primary identity. A brand/category option route is conditional on segment cash evidence; unproved growth-return value is excluded from base.

strongest_rival: A scaled appliance competitor with stronger brand pull and channel economics could capture branded profit pools while forcing 莱克电气 to compete on price, compressing margins and cash conversion.
reversal_observations: Post-cutoff reports show adjusted profit and operating cash recovering together without disproportionate working-capital growth.
Disclosures identify customer concentration, brand/ODM economics and subsidiary cash accessibility sufficiently to reconcile earnings to ordinary-shareholder cash.
New category or capacity investments report matched incremental earnings and owner cash after total working-capital and long-lived-asset spending.

component_treatments.reason: Consolidated adjusted earnings and operating cash are directly observed over FY2015-FY2017.
component_treatments.investment_consequence: Forms the base earnings and owner-cash anchor, subject to cyclical margin and FX pressure.
component_treatments.promotion_or_resolution_condition: Maintain base treatment while consolidated adjusted profit and cash remain observable across normal years.

component_treatments.reason: Domestic brands and online/direct channels are disclosed, but no brand-level profit or cash data are supplied.
component_treatments.investment_consequence: Can support a conditional uplift only after segment economics are reconciled.
component_treatments.promotion_or_resolution_condition: Promote when brand-level margins, repeat demand and cash conversion are disclosed for a mature period.

component_treatments.reason: Receivables, inventory and payables are disclosed and materially changed with scale.
component_treatments.investment_consequence: Included in owner-cash and financing-pressure analysis rather than treated as costless growth.
component_treatments.promotion_or_resolution_condition: Retain when working-capital balances and operating cash are reported consistently.

component_treatments.reason: Consolidated cash is substantial and unrestricted in the reports, but entity-level accessibility and non-controlling claims are not fully mapped.
component_treatments.investment_consequence: Provides a conditional liquidity buffer, not an automatic ordinary-shareholder distribution claim.
component_treatments.promotion_or_resolution_condition: Promote when parent/subsidiary ownership, restrictions and distributions reconcile cash to ordinary holders.

component_treatments.reason: Category expansion and new subsidiaries are described without matched incremental return evidence.
component_treatments.investment_consequence: Exclude growth premium from base and test total capital absorption in scenarios.
component_treatments.promotion_or_resolution_condition: Promote only with project-level capital, working-capital absorption and incremental owner-cash evidence.

component_decisions.promotion_test: Consolidated adjusted profit and cash remain stable through a normal input-cost cycle.
component_decisions.invalidation_test: Persistent profit and cash decline unrelated to temporary working-capital timing.

component_decisions.promotion_test: Brand-level economics and cash conversion are disclosed over a mature period.
component_decisions.invalidation_test: Brand growth requires persistent discounting or absorbs cash without margin improvement.

component_decisions.promotion_test: Cash conversion tracks earnings as receivables and inventory normalize.
component_decisions.invalidation_test: Working-capital growth persistently consumes operating cash or requires new debt.

component_decisions.promotion_test: Entity-level restrictions and distributions establish ordinary-shareholder accessibility.
component_decisions.invalidation_test: Cash is trapped, pledged or offset by claims not visible in consolidated balances.

component_decisions.promotion_test: Matched project returns exceed all capital and working-capital commitments.
component_decisions.invalidation_test: Expansion continues without incremental earnings or cash evidence.

evidence_trace.scope: Consolidated adjusted and reported net profit
Brands, domestic channels and ODM model

underwriting_thesis.central_path: A diversified appliance and motor platform can support a consolidated mature owner-cash base, but declining FY2017 cash conversion, customer concentration and unproved category returns require conditional treatment of brand growth and cash accessibility.
underwriting_thesis.normal_earnings_treatment: Underwrite a consolidated FY2015-FY2017 adjusted-profit range; do not add unsupported segment growth.
underwriting_thesis.owner_cash_treatment: Anchor on operating cash after considering working-capital absorption; recognize consolidated cash only conditionally pending accessibility evidence.
underwriting_thesis.permanent_loss_treatment: Treat slow margin erosion, cash absorption and low-return retention as material permanent-loss paths despite reported liquidity.
underwriting_thesis.value_route_treatment: Use ROUTE:BASE_OWNER_CASH as primary, ROUTE:BRAND_OPTION as conditional primary, and exclude ROUTE:UNPROVED_GROWTH from base.
underwriting_thesis.strongest_rival: A scaled appliance competitor with stronger brand pull and channel economics could capture branded profit pools while forcing 莱克电气 to compete on price, compressing margins and cash conversion.
underwriting_thesis.monitoring: Track adjusted profit, operating cash, receivables/inventory intensity, customer concentration, borrowing and disclosed project-level returns at the feedback clocks.

investment_treatment: Pre-outcome research treatment: conditionally underwrite the mature consolidated owner-cash engine, keep brand/category growth conditional, and require reversal evidence before promoting excluded growth or cash-accessibility assumptions.

basis.metric: 归母扣除非经常性损益后净利润
basis.operating_perimeter: Consolidated 莱克电气 and subsidiaries

rows.economic_reason: Observed FY2015-FY2017 adjusted-profit span is the consolidated mature reference.

quantification.reason: No brand-level profit or cash disclosure permits a bounded adjustment.
quantification.conservative_treatment: Do not add to base earnings; retain as conditional only.

rows.economic_reason: Brand and channel adaptation is evidenced qualitatively but not economically quantified.

delta.conservative_treatment: Keep brand-channel earnings conditional and add no numeric sensitivity.

owner_cash.basis: Collection and payment terms by customer are not disclosed.

delta.conservative_treatment: Do not alter the base owner-cash range.

driver_sensitivity_specs.responsibility_boundary: Applies only to brand/channel economics and customer-linked cash conversion; consolidated mature-core observations remain separate.
